Select distinct IC50 activity records for compounds tested against human interleukin‑1 receptor‑associated kinase 4. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'interleukin‑1 receptor‑associated kinase 4' and organism 'Homo sapiens' (tax_id 9606). Filter activities by standard_type 'IC50' and standard_units 'nM'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
